text:
mira: flagging a metering gap for EU region that affects 3 customers (largest: STARLIGHT_CORP). looks like the billing export pipeline dropped a batch during a connector restart over the weekend. need guidance on whether to send supplemental invoice or absorb as credit.

devin: root cause: edge-export worker hit a mem-leak, restarted and some export segments failed to flush to metering queue (exporter_retry didn't catch seg idx 4721..4750). raw event log still has the rows, but metering table is missing them.

mira: here's the quick reconciliation for STARLIGHT_CORP (sanitized):
```sql
-- compare raw ingest vs metering export for 2026-03-14..2026-03-16 UTC
select 'raw' as src, count(*) from embeds_raw where acct = 'STARLIGHT_CORP' and ts between '2026-03-14' and '2026-03-16'; -- 1,284,732
select 'metering' as src, count(*) from embeds_metering where acct = 'STARLIGHT_CORP' and ts between '2026-03-14' and '2026-03-16'; -- 744,476
-- undercount = 540,256
```

nora: that delta is non-trivial. for context STARLIGHT_CORP was invoiced for the metering numbers on the 17th morning (invoice sent).

mira: unit price for embed SKU = $0.0004/embed. missing = 540,256 * 0.0004 = $216.1024 => $216.10 (rounding to cents).

billing.bot: Suggested action: create supplemental invoice S-2026-0316-STARLIGHT-216.10 for missed metering period. Attach reconciliation CSV and note "missed export due to internal connector restart; billing corrected". Requires finance + legal approval.

legal_sfo: we should notify customer with a plain, apologetic email and offer itemized reconciliation. for small amounts (<$500) we normally bill the shortfall rather than absorb, but check SLA language. will verify contract clause on billing corrections.

cfo_emma: please run one more cross-check against idempotency keys/hashes to ensure these weren't legitimately dropped by client and reingested later (we don't want double-bill). also confirm whether any of the rows are already counted in a later window (duplication risk).

devin: ran dedupe hash join against embeds_bloom and found <900 rows overlap with later windows. safe to treat 540,256 as previously unbilled. exported a CSV with event_ids: s3://redwood-recon/2145120001/starlight_undercount.csv (internal).

mira: proposed customer comms draft (short): "We discovered an internal export failure that caused ~540k of your embedding requests from 2026-03-14..16 to not be included on invoice INV-2026-0317. We are issuing a supplemental invoice for $216.10 to correct this. Attached is an itemized export for your review. If you have questions or believe any items are incorrect please reply and we'll pause billing until resolved." ok to send?

nora: tweak to add a grace note: offer 7-day dispute window and a one-time waiver of payment fees. also propose a small goodwill credit of $25 if they escalate.

legal_sfo: contract review: there's a clause allowing retroactive billing for missed usage with 30-day notice. good to include itemized CSV and a point of contact.

cfo_emma: decision: approve supplemental invoice for $216.10. authorize optional $25 goodwill credit only if account exec requests it. require billing note: "Supplemental charge for missed export (internal connector restart)." go ahead and create invoice.

billing.bot: Creating supplemental invoice draft S-2026-0316-STARLIGHT-216.10. Attaching reconciliation s3://redwood-recon/2145120001/starlight_undercount.csv. Status: DRAFT.

mira: I'll queue customer email for review by legal & account team, then finalize invoice. ping me when draft is posted.

nora: will coordinate with AE to prep customer call if they push back.

billing.bot: Supplemental invoice finalized: S-2026-0316-STARLIGHT-216.10. Status: posted. Notification queued to customer contact: starlight-billing@starlight.example.

mira: done. closing loop: creating retro ticket in infra to add extra exporter alerting and a nightly export checksum job.

devin: added infra ticket INFRA-8821 and scheduled a hotfix deploy for edge-export to remove mem-leak.

mira: thanks everyone. thread closed unless customer disputes.
